name: openspec_verify
description: Combine child-workflow state, blocking checks, and semantic OpenSpec conformance into a lifecycle gate.

findings.description: Semantic conformance findings; passed through to the output verbatim.

child.description: Outcome of the downstream execution (campaign or parallel-merge child workflow).

outcome.description: Child outcome; checked for 'verified' when selectedMode is campaign.

conflicts.description: Truthy when the parallel-merge child left unresolved conflicts; checked when selectedMode is not campaign.

blockingPassed.description: Whether all blocking checks passed; defaults to true when absent.

selectedMode.description: Routing decision from openspec_route; determines how child outcome is interpreted.

passed.description: Overall lifecycle gate verdict: semantic.passed AND child outcome ok AND checks.blockingPassed.

childPassed.description: Child-workflow verdict: outcome == 'verified' for campaign mode, or absence of conflicts otherwise.

checksPassed.description: Value of checks.blockingPassed (default true when absent).

semantic.description: Semantic check input, passed through unchanged.

findings.description: Semantic conformance findings; empty array when semantic.findings is absent.
